setlist.title: And We Bid You Good Night

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls the Star medley the bright spot, with Phil prominent throughout the show; Reviewer says the Dark Star climaxes out of nowhere [7][10][12]
- **Mountains Of The Moon** (1 review): Segues into Dark Star, creating a hushed atmosphere; both versions are nice but not the band's best [8]
- **Hard To Handle** (1 review): Reviewer especially likes Jerry's pedal steel playing on this song and on Cosmic Charlie [9]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 other source): Bobby noodles the opening chords of Weather Report Prelude just before Cryptical Envelopment and again before Alligator [1]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): The first Eleven stops after the William Tell intro, then abruptly segues into Lovelight; the instrumental section returns later in the set [11]
- **Alligator** (1 review): Jerry asked the crowd for requests; one man shouted for Alligator and Phil launched into it with bombs [10]
- **Feedback** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Feedback exceptional, with broad electronic strokes [8]

## The recordings

- **gd69-04-05.sbd.miller.18701.sbesok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4.57/5 by 53 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard sound excellent; Slight hiss makes the reviewer doubt the lineage is as pure as stated, though it comes from Charlie Miller; Reviewer praises the clean sound quality of the recording [4][7][14]
- **gd1969-04-05.136650.sbd.reelmaster.dat.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 134 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1969-04-05.sbd.squirlin.65.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 131 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says they heard these were the last shows at the Avalon Ballroom [6]
- Reviewer says it was overshadowed by the late-February to early-March Fillmore run, and came before the band's country turn later in 1969 [4]
- Reviewer would place it in the top 10 of 1969 shows, though they know little of that year [7]
- Reviewer names the late-February to early-March Fillmore run as one of three peak runs of 1969 [13]
- Reviewer considers February through May 1969 a peak period for the band [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-04-05.sbd.miller.18701.sbesok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1969-04-05.136650.sbd.reelmaster.dat.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Anonomous; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > Dat (48k) [2]
- **gd1969-04-05.sbd.squirlin.65.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by squirlin; source: SBD > REEL > REEL > DAT > SP/DIF > HD > SHN [3]
